newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Waukesha County, Wis..
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Waukesha County, Wis..

text.p: Until June 10, 1997, at 1:00 P.M., Central Daylight Savings Time, sealed bids only will be received at the Director's Office, Waukesha County Department of
Administration, 1320 Pewaukee Road, Room 310, Waukesha, Wisconsin, for the above issue to be dated June 1, 1997, and to mature December 1,
Year Amount Year Amount Year Amount

The Notes constitute the general obligation of Waukesha County, issued for public purposes. The Notes will be designated as qualified tax-exempt obligations.'' The Depository Trust Company book-entry-only system will be utilized in connection with the issuance of the Notes. Legal opinion: Quarles & Brady. Additional information and a copy of the Near Final Official Statement and Notice of Note Sale, which set forth additional details concerning the issue and limitations on the bids to be received, may be obtained from: Hutchinson, Shockey, Erley & Co., 200 North Jefferson Street, Suite 100, Milwaukee, Wisconsin 53202, (414) 298-9898, financial advisor to the County, or the undersigned.
